tonight.headline: Zvada is still a free agent — and he locks at 19:15 tonight
body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten's Wednesday DNP (ankle/foot) is confirmed, and his fallback Woody Marks is now questionable himself — limited Wednesday with a knee (houstontexans.com 11 Nov; RotoWire 12 Nov). Jacobs is out and Green Bay decide on IR Saturday; Loveland is on bye; Wilson and Pickens are questionable on the bench.

ESPN: 126.3 to 129.0, 49%. Two free moves from yesterday are still not made at 12:50Z: add Dominic Zvada for Matt Gay before the Giants kick off tonight at 19:15 CDMX, and start Gordon over Marks at FLEX by Sunday noon. Then one check at 10:30 Sunday: if Tuten is out, Marks takes his slot — or, if Marks is out too, Gordon moves to RB and Wilson takes the FLEX.

doFirst.title: Add Dominic Zvada, drop Matt Gay
doFirst.subtitle: Free agent — no priority spent. Still not made at 12:50Z; it has to happen before 19:15 CDMX tonight.

case.label: The gap
case.body: Zvada 10.7, Gay 8.3: 2.4 points, the biggest kicker gap on either roster. Zvada is still a FREEAGENT in IPADE at 12:50Z, so the add costs nothing that lasts.

case.label: The kicker
case.body: Giants rookie; missed three field goals in the Week 5 overtime tie with Washington (FantasyNerds 11 Oct) — the same opponent tonight. Not on the Giants' final report (giants.com 11 Nov: only Malik Harrison listed).

case.label: The drop
case.body: Gay, 53% rostered — disagreeing with the market on the record: K17 this week, and Las Vegas now start rookie Fernando Mendoza after trading Kirk Cousins (Yahoo 11 Nov). Gay offers nothing Zvada does not.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gay outscores Zvada in Week 10 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Gordon at FLEX, bench Marks
doFirst.subtitle: The projection's FLEX by 1.8 — a coin flip, so it goes to the projection and carries no thesis. Marks is now questionable (knee).

case.label: The call
case.body: Gordon 15.8, Marks 14.0 (lineup_check.py: COIN FLIP). Marks went in for Jacobs at 05:28 CDMX; the projection prefers Gordon.

case.label: What research adds
case.body: Gordon gets Kyle McCord's first start and had 94% of Miami's carries in Week 9 (archive). Marks was limited Wednesday with a knee and is now questionable (houstontexans.com 11 Nov; RotoWire 12 Nov) — ESPN's tag is in the snapshot, so the 14.0 has had the chance to price it. Neither is a reason to override; the projection already prefers Gordon.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Marks outscores Gordon in Week 10 (archive). No decision-log entry: coin flip.
